### Base policies governing the subjects (whole domain)

`cash_evt_error_resolution` → `doc_cash_error_resolution_2cafe985` + facet `doc_cash_holds_and_error_claim_periods_7e4e95aa`: three error kinds; customer's own assertion; window 180 days from the disclosed date (on time on the last day; worked 10 Jan → 9 Jul correct); one open notice per kind; decision due notice + 90 days (5 Mar → 3 Jun correct); no-error when the cause lies with the customer; on error-found every fee refunded as Paloma error unless already refunded under the on-time promise; remedy only after error-found; wrong-person → refund or re-issue at no cost funded by Paloma (error-refund / error-re-issue credit), customer's choice; incorrect amount → credit booked, choice of re-issue for the shortfall alone or refund (error-shortfall basis); not-available-by-date → fee refund; refund within refund business days / re-issue within re-issue business days of the choice. All carried, untriggered branches included.
`cash_evt_refunds` (error-shortfall basis, closing exception) → `doc_cash_refund_rules_7243b53b`: carried.
`cash_evt_availability_and_holds` → `doc_cash_availability_payout_and_holds_34a4471d` + facet tables: carried (refused-pickup count uses the `cash_msr_refused_pickups` window "on or after its current available date", worked hold table consistent).
Variant figures read by this task (Express pickup window 30; refund 1; re-issue 1; notice 180; decision 90) and all other tiers: checked cell by cell against `variants` — all equal.
